async def act(page):
    """
    From the current New Product edit page (Purple variant open), ensure the required Status is set to "Enabled",
    then click Save as the final action (the Save click may navigate away).

    This uses only accessibility selectors per instructions (page.get_by_role and .select_option).
    """

    # Try to set Status to Enabled. Use the explicit name seen in the accessibility tree first.
    try:
        await page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Status *").select_option(option_name="Enabled")
    except Exception:
        try:
            # fallback to the variant without the asterisk
            await page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Status").select_option(option_name="Enabled")
        except Exception:
            # If the Status control is not present or cannot be set, continue to attempt save anyway
            pass

    # Small pause to let the UI update before saving
    await page.wait_for_timeout(300)

    # Final action: click Save (may navigate away). This must be the last interactive action.
    try:
        await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save").click()
    except Exception:
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save and Continue Edit").click()
        except Exception:
            # If no save button is found, nothing more to do from this state
            return

    # allow time for save to process
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)

    return

async def act(page):
    """
    From the current New Product edit page (Purple variant open), ensure the required Status is set to "Enabled",
    then click Save as the final action (the Save click may navigate away).

    This uses only accessibility selectors per instructions (page.get_by_role and .select_option).
    """

    # Try to set Status to Enabled. Use the explicit name seen in the accessibility tree first.
    try:
        await page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Status *").select_option(option_name="Enabled")
    except Exception:
        try:
            # fallback to the variant without the asterisk
            await page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Status").select_option(option_name="Enabled")
        except Exception:
            # If the Status control is not present or cannot be set, continue to attempt save anyway
            pass

    # Small pause to let the UI update before saving
    await page.wait_for_timeout(300)

    # Final action: click Save (may navigate away). This must be the last interactive action.
    try:
        await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save").click()
    except Exception:
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save and Continue Edit").click()
        except Exception:
            # If no save button is found, nothing more to do from this state
            return

    # allow time for save to process
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)

    return

async def act(page):
    """
    From the current New Product edit page (Purple variant open), ensure the required Status is set to "Enabled",
    then click Save as the final action (the Save click may navigate away).

    This uses only accessibility selectors per instructions (page.get_by_role and .select_option).
    """

    # Try to set Status to Enabled. Use the explicit name seen in the accessibility tree first.
    try:
        await page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Status *").select_option(option_name="Enabled")
    except Exception:
        try:
            # fallback to the variant without the asterisk
            await page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Status").select_option(option_name="Enabled")
        except Exception:
            # If the Status control is not present or cannot be set, continue to attempt save anyway
            pass

    # Small pause to let the UI update before saving
    await page.wait_for_timeout(300)

    # Final action: click Save (may navigate away). This must be the last interactive action.
    try:
        await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save").click()
    except Exception:
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save and Continue Edit").click()
        except Exception:
            # If no save button is found, nothing more to do from this state
            return

    # allow time for save to process
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)

    return
